Currency: INR (₹). The live plans page is authoritative for current price, inclusions and billing terms.

## Business overview

Sudarshan AI Labs supports MSMEs with discovery, digital experiences, lead conversion and customer follow-up. Depending on the agreed scope, work can include local SEO, Google Business Profile support, websites, landing pages, social media marketing, paid advertising, lead generation, content, WhatsApp automation and practical AI systems.

The Build, Automate, Transfer approach documents agreed work and supports transfer of relevant assets and knowledge to the client. Exact deliverables and responsibilities are defined before work begins. Results depend on each business, its offer, market, budget and follow-up capacity; rankings, leads, revenue and fixed returns are not guaranteed.
